title: Data-Driven Priors for Uncertainty-Aware Risk Prediction of Clinical Deterioration using Multimodal Data
abstract: arXiv:2603.08459v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Safe predictions are a crucial requirement for integrating predictive models into clinical decision support systems. One approach to improving trustworthiness is to enable models to express uncertainty about individual predictions. However, current machine learning models frequently lack reliable uncertainty estimation, hindering real-world deployment. This limitation is particularly evident in multimodal settings, where models must effectively integrate heterogeneous information. In this work, we propose MedCertAIn, a predictive uncertainty framework that leverages multimodal clinical data to improve model performance and reliability for in-hospital mortality risk prediction as an indicator of patient deterioration. We design data-driven priors over neural network parameters using a hybrid strategy that considers cross-modal similarity in self-supervised latent representations and modality-specific data corruptions. translated_title: 利用多模态数据进行不确定性感知临床恶化风险预测的数据驱动先验
translated_abstract: 安全预测是将预测模型集成到临床决策支持系统中的关键要求。提高模型可信度的一种方法是让模型能够对个体预测表达不确定性。然而，当前的机器学习模型通常缺乏可靠的不确定性估计，阻碍了其在现实世界中的部署。这一局限性在多模态场景中尤为明显，因为模型必须有效整合异构信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了MedCertAIn，一个预测不确定性框架，它利用多模态临床数据来提升住院死亡风险预测（作为患者恶化的指标）的模型性能和可靠性。我们采用混合策略设计了基于数据驱动的神经网络参数先验，该策略同时考虑了自监督潜在表示中的跨模态相似性以及特定模态的数据损坏。我们训练并评估……
tldr: 提出MedCertAIn框架，通过基于自监督跨模态相似性和模态特定数据损坏设计的数据驱动先验，为多模态临床数据下的住院死亡风险预测提供可靠的不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: We propose MedCertAIn, an uncertainty-aware framework for in-hospital mortality risk prediction that improves reliability of multimodal clinical predictions via data-driven priors derived from cross-modal similarity in self-supervised representations and modality-specific data corruptions.
